fleet.tiers: Standard advertises on-demand access up to 128 GPUs; Enterprise advertises thousands through contact.
fleet.notes: 128 is published Standard-plan GPU ceiling, not reserved inventory or proof of bypassing billing/anti-abuse checks. CPU/instance quotas, verification and review time not published.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: This action is irreversible. Make sure to back up any important data before destroying a cluster.
snapshot_auto.note: Clusters have only create/edit/destroy (no stop/sleep); nothing is saved automatically. Persistence is via attached storage volumes or object storage.

snapshot_on_demand.note: Full API/CLI index (cluster, job, storage, object-storage, ssh, user endpoints) has no snapshot/image/checkpoint operation. Absence inferred from complete API index, not an explicit statement.

harness_api.quote: The TensorPool Agent is an autonomous monitoring and recovery system for long-running distributed training jobs on Kubernetes, Slurm, or TensorPool Jobs.
harness_api.note: TensorPool Agent (beta) is a provider-side SRE agent that watches training jobs and tries recovery; configured in the dashboard, not a prompt/stream/follow-up API for a coding-agent harness inside the machine.

guest_firewall.note: Dedicated GPU nodes/VMs with SSH and sudo (docs use 'sudo apt install'); iptables/nftables should work. Not stated in docs.

volume_attach.quote: Storage volumes are high-performance shared volumes designed for distributed training on multi-node clusters.
volume_attach.note: tp storage create <size_gb>; tp cluster attach <cluster_id> <storage_id>; mounted at /mnt/<storage_id> on each instance; attach/detach restarts all cluster nodes. Only attachable to multi-node GPU clusters and CPU instances. $100/TB-month (live pricing page: 'Shared Storage $100 / TB / month'). Object storage (S3) can be FUSE-mounted by the user via rclone.

volume_shared.quote: Shared data: Attach the same storage volume to multiple clusters to share data
volume_shared.note: POSIX shared filesystem mounted read-write on every node of a multi-node cluster and attachable to several clusters at once. Org-scoped S3 object storage is also shared.
